execution_policy.advance_rule: Only start a ready item whose dependencies are passed. After passing it, mark direct successors ready only when all their dependencies are passed.
execution_policy.stop_rule: Stop on any unexplained parity mismatch, destructive data incompatibility, security regression, or failed VALUE-001/VALUE-002 gate. Keep Go production and do not change thresholds after observing Rust results.

items.title: Port full sidecar and retrieval stack
items.note: Integrated ce97dcf1 passes full immutable fixture generation/application, eight Go/Rust differentials and 204 CLI/index/protocol tests on Darwin/arm64 and Linux/arm64. Shared CLI/MCP local HyDE expansion preserves Go prompt, cache, dimensions and failure behavior; success bodies are bounded to 4 MiB. Integrated 3d4d8a56 additionally preserves the inert Go rerank flag in real CLI/MCP processes; complete immutable generation/application and the same native eight differentials/204 tests pass. Remaining facades/formats/quantization and other native targets stay open. Integrated a427ce7b additionally connects offline Ask CLI to shared hybrid retrieval and SearchPlan: seven Go cases, nine native differentials and 205 CLI/index/protocol tests pass on Darwin/arm64 and Linux/arm64; other facades and platforms remain open. Integrated bacaaff8 additionally preserves inert Go backend/quantization config through real CLI/MCP cases; immutable generation/application, nine differentials and 205 tests pass on both native ARM64 hosts. Current HTTP Ask candidate `7ae8ae34` (same production tree as immutable-fixture commit `e210b837`, Q=`368c2365`) adds shared hybrid retrieval for unscoped nonempty-index Ask while preserving notebook-scoped sidecar behavior; two source-bound Go cases passed with fake-loopback requests. Darwin/arm64 evidence: 16 CLI and 233 HTTP differentials, 210 CLI/index/protocol tests, strict Clippy/fmt, and validated immutable fixture application. Linux and other required native targets remain unverified for this slice; RUST-008 stays open. The bounded index status CLI slice (#1225) has 85 fresh Go/Rust pairs and 344 hash-verified output streams at d9bd9ebf38b47c98e33191e650c98569196250e0 on Darwin/arm64. Its source-bound native gate is scripts/rust-port/index-status/verify.py; Linux/Windows and final integrated-head CI remain acceptance requirements, not inferred from cross-compilation. See the bounded index status section of contract-matrix.md. This slice does not close INDEX-002, INDEX-005 or parent #1136.
